name: AgroSky Agricultural Spraying Drone
alt: AgroSky agricultural spraying drone releasing a fine mist over a green crop field
summary: A spraying drone that boosts yield by applying pesticides and fertilizers efficiently across large acreage.
description: Built on the EFT E610P heavy-lift platform, the AgroSky spraying drone carries up to 16 litres per sortie and covers ground a manual sprayer cannot match. Uniform droplet distribution reduces chemical waste, while the operator stays clear of exposure. Supplied assembled, calibrated and field-tested, with pilot handover included.
highlights: Keeps operators away from chemical exposure

name: AgroSky Surveillance Drone
alt: AgroSky surveillance drone flying at altitude for aerial monitoring and mapping
summary: A surveillance drone that enhances security with real-time aerial monitoring and high-resolution imaging.
description: Configured for perimeter security, land surveying and environmental monitoring. Streams live video to the ground station and captures survey-grade imagery for orthomosaic mapping — suited to agriculture, construction and infrastructure inspection.

name: AgroSky Firefighting Drone
alt: AgroSky firefighting drone providing live aerial footage above an active fire zone
summary: A firefighting drone that aids in detection, suppression and rescue — improving both safety and efficiency.
description: Thermal-capable UAV that maps fire zones in real time, locates hotspots through smoke and gives incident commanders a live overhead view. Supports suppression payloads and search-and-rescue coordination.

name: AgroSky Human-Flying Drone
alt: AgroSky human-flying drone concept for personal air mobility and short-range transport
summary: AgroSky's personal air mobility platform, revolutionising short-range transport with efficient electric flight.
description: Our next-generation passenger UAV programme. Designed around redundant electric propulsion and autonomous flight control for efficient short-range personal transport. Available for partnership, demonstration and pilot deployments.

name: EFT E610P 10L 6 Axis Agricultural Drone Frame
alt: EFT E610P 10L six-axis agricultural drone frame with folding arms and spray tank mount
summary: Six-axis 10-litre agricultural airframe in advanced engineering material — strong, smooth and quick to assemble.
description: The EFT E610P is the workhorse frame behind most 10-litre spraying builds in India. Made from advanced engineering material that stays strong and smooth under repeated field use, with folding arms that make it easy to assemble, disassemble and transport between plots.
highlights: Made by advanced engineering material — super strong and smooth

name: EFT E610P 16L 6 Axis Agricultural Drone Frame
alt: EFT E610P 16L six-axis agricultural drone frame built for a 16 litre spray tank
summary: The 16-litre variant of the E610P — same proven six-axis airframe, more chemical per sortie.
description: Identical construction to the 10L E610P but sized for a 16-litre tank, so you make fewer refill trips across large holdings. Advanced engineering material keeps the airframe rigid under a heavier sloshing payload while remaining easy to assemble and disassemble.
highlights: Made by advanced engineering material — super strong and smooth

name: EFT E416P Agricultural Drone Frame
alt: EFT E416P four-axis agricultural drone frame with 34 inch folding propeller mounts
summary: Four-axis 16-litre frame with 34-inch folding props and a 37 kg take-off ceiling — the heavy hauler.
description: A quad configuration that trades rotor count for larger discs: 34-inch folding propellers lift a 37 kg maximum take-off weight, the highest in our frame range. Fewer motors also means a simpler, cheaper power system to maintain.
highlights: Highest take-off weight in the range — 37 kg

name: S500 Drone Frame
alt: S500 quadcopter drone frame kit with integrated PCB arms and landing gear
summary: The classic 500 mm quadcopter frame — the standard starting point for training and prototype builds.
description: A 500 mm wheelbase quad frame with integrated power-distribution arms. Inexpensive, widely supported and forgiving, which makes it the frame we recommend for pilot training, first builds and payload prototyping before committing to an agricultural airframe.
highlights: Widely supported and easy to source parts for

name: S550 Drone Frame
alt: S550 hexacopter drone frame kit with six arms and integrated power distribution board
summary: Six-arm 550 mm frame — the redundancy of a hexacopter at training-build cost.
description: Steps up from the S500 with two extra arms, giving you motor redundancy and more lift for camera or sensor payloads. A sensible bridge between a hobby quad and a full agricultural platform.

name: Hobbywing X9 Plus 36190 Drone Motors
alt: Hobbywing X9 Plus 36190 brushless drone motor for heavy-lift agricultural multirotors
summary: Hobbywing's heavy-lift X9 Plus power system — the standard drive for 16 L agricultural platforms.
description: The X9 Plus 36190 is an integrated motor-and-ESC power system built specifically for agricultural multirotors. Sealed against dust and chemical mist, it is the unit most 16-litre sprayers in the field run on, and the one we stock deepest.

specs.label: Protection
specs.value: Sealed against dust and spray mist

name: Hobbywing XRotor X6 Plus 150KV Brushless Motor and 2480 Folding Propeller - CCW
alt: Hobbywing XRotor X6 Plus 150KV brushless motor paired with a 2480 CCW folding propeller
summary: Matched X6 Plus 150KV motor and 2480 folding propeller, supplied as a balanced CCW pair.
description: Buying the motor and propeller as a matched combo removes the guesswork — the 150KV winding and 24×8 folding prop are paired by Hobbywing for the thrust band agricultural hexacopters actually operate in. Supplied in CCW rotation.

name: Hobbywing X8 Motor and X8 3090 or 3011 Folding Propeller Combo Kit – CCW/CW
alt: Hobbywing X8 motor with 3090 and 3011 folding propeller combo kit in CW and CCW rotation
summary: X8 combo kit with a choice of 3090 or 3011 folding propellers, available in both rotations.
description: Combo hardware for the Hobbywing X8 power system, offered with either the 3090 or 3011 folding propeller and in CW or CCW rotation so you can complete or repair a set without over-ordering. Confirm rotation and propeller size on enquiry.

name: Hobbywing X8 3011 Propeller
alt: Hobbywing X8 3011 folding propeller blade for heavy-lift agricultural drones
summary: 30-inch folding propeller for the X8 power system, balanced for large agricultural airframes.
description: A 30×11 folding blade matched to the Hobbywing X8 motor. The larger disc moves more air at lower RPM, which means less vibration through the airframe and quieter, more efficient sorties on heavy platforms.

name: Hobbywing X6 Plus 2480 Propellers with Hub – CCW
alt: Black Hobbywing X6 Plus 2480 two-blade CCW propeller supplied with mounting hub
summary: 24-inch two-blade CCW propeller supplied complete with its mounting hub — a direct-fit replacement.
description: Replacement blades for X6 Plus powered hexacopters, shipped with the hub already fitted so a field swap takes minutes rather than a rebuild. Two-blade 24×8 geometry in counter-clockwise rotation.

name: Pixhawk Flight Controller
alt: Pixhawk flight controller autopilot board with connector harness for multirotor drones
summary: The open-source autopilot standard — mission planning, failsafes and telemetry on proven firmware.
description: Pixhawk runs the ArduPilot and PX4 firmware that most of the commercial UAV world is built on. Waypoint missions, return-to-home failsafes, geofencing and full telemetry logging, with an ecosystem of documentation and support no proprietary controller matches.

name: Pixhawk Cube Flight Controller
alt: Pixhawk Cube flight controller with vibration-isolated triple-redundant IMU module
summary: Triple-redundant IMUs on a vibration-isolated core — the commercial-grade Pixhawk.
description: The Cube moves the sensors onto a vibration-isolated, temperature-controlled module carrying three redundant IMUs. On a spraying platform where a 25 kg airframe shakes hard and flies all day, that redundancy is the difference between a logged anomaly and a lost aircraft.

name: NAZA M V2 & GPS Combo
alt: NAZA M V2 flight controller bundled with its GPS and compass module
summary: Compact NAZA M V2 controller bundled with its GPS and compass module — a dependable entry autopilot.
description: A straightforward, well-proven controller for smaller multirotors and training airframes. The bundled GPS/compass module adds position hold and return-to-home without the setup depth a Pixhawk demands, which makes it a good fit for first builds.
highlights: Ideal for S500 / S550 training builds

name: K++ V2 Flight Controller Kit
alt: K++ V2 agricultural flight controller kit with GPS modules, radio and wiring harness
summary: Complete agricultural flight-control kit — dual GPS, radio and spraying logic, integrated out of the box.
description: The K++ V2 is purpose-built for spraying operations rather than adapted to them. Terrain-following, AB-line and full-field autonomous routes come standard, along with flow-linked spray rate so your application stays uniform even when ground speed changes. Supplied as a complete kit.
highlights: Speed-linked spray rate for uniform application
Complete kit — controller, GPS, radio and harness

name: K3 Apro Flight Controller Kit
alt: K3 Apro agricultural flight controller kit with GPS module and ground station radio
summary: The value agricultural control kit — autonomous spraying routes at roughly half the K++ V2 price.
description: K3 Apro covers the operations most contractors actually fly: manual assist, AB-line spraying and route memory, with GPS positioning and a ground-station radio in the box. A sensible choice when you want autonomous spraying without the full K++ V2 feature set.

specs.label: Modes
specs.value: Manual assist, AB route, route memory

name: Dual Head Extended Spray Nozzle
alt: Dual head extended spray nozzle assembly for agricultural drone boom arms
summary: Two-head extended nozzle that widens the swath per arm — the cheapest coverage upgrade you can make.
description: Mounts on the boom arm and puts two spray heads where one used to sit, widening the effective swath without touching your flight plan. At this price it is usually the first upgrade we recommend to operators chasing more acres per day.
highlights: Two heads per arm for a wider swath

name: Dual Header Y-Type Spray Nozzle
alt: Dual header Y-type spray nozzle set for uniform droplet distribution on drone spray booms
summary: Y-split dual-header nozzle set engineered for even droplet distribution across the full swath.
description: The Y-type body splits flow evenly between two heads, so pressure — and therefore droplet size — stays consistent across the boom. Even coverage is what actually determines whether a chemical works, and this is the nozzle set we fit to most 16 L builds.
highlights: Consistent droplet size across the boom
Fitted as standard on our 16 L builds

name: Centrifugal Nozzles
alt: Centrifugal atomising spray nozzles with rotating discs for drone crop spraying
summary: Rotary atomisers that set droplet size by disc speed — fine, uniform coverage with far less drift.
description: Instead of forcing liquid through an orifice, centrifugal nozzles fling it off a spinning disc, so droplet size is controlled by RPM rather than pressure. That gives you a much tighter droplet spectrum, better canopy penetration and noticeably less drift on breezy days.
highlights: Droplet size set by RPM, not pressure

name: Landing Gear Bar φ20*500 / Compatible with E410P & E610P
alt: 20 mm by 500 mm carbon landing gear bar compatible with EFT E410P and E610P frames
summary: 20 mm × 500 mm landing gear bar — the direct replacement for EFT E410P and E610P airframes.
description: Landing gear takes the abuse in agricultural flying: hard field landings, bunds, stubble. This is the exact φ20×500 bar EFT fits to the E410P and E610P, so a damaged leg is a ten-minute swap rather than a workshop visit.
highlights: Keep one as a field spare
